scope: Automatic native array grids with legacy Boolean hidden-row bindings, macOS 26.7 and actual 4D 20.8 desktop execution
before: The unchanged provider disables this valid grid; the interpreted fixture fails at Logical grid not published.
semantics: True hides the row; False preserves ordinary native permissions. LongInt hidden/disabled/unselectable flags remain supported. No host array conversion or new hook.
